local_facts.claim: Dallas adopted its 2021 Energy Conservation Code effective May 12, 2023. Its residential fenestration tables set maximum U-factor and solar heat-gain-coefficient (SHGC) requirements, so a replacement-window specification needs to account for more than frame size and appearance.
local_facts.why_it_matters: U-factor and SHGC are practical inputs for choosing replacement glass in sun-exposed Dallas rooms. The technician checks the opening and discusses the glass package along with shade, orientation, and frame condition before the installation is scoped.
local_facts.title: Dallas window replacements are subject to current energy-code performance limits

local_facts.claim: The City of Dallas says replacing and repairing damaged windows typically does not require a permit. Its permit FAQ also says that work affecting structural elements and exterior work in historic, conservation, or planned-development districts can follow different approval requirements.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A straightforward damaged-window replacement can be planned differently from an opening resize, structural repair, or work in a special district. The project scope should be checked before materials are ordered rather than relying on a generic doors-and-windows rule.
local_facts.title: Dallas has a window-specific permit distinction

local_facts.claim: Dallas has extensive mid-century housing, and a Dallas history publication describes aluminum windows as a common feature of 1960s houses. Preservation Dallas has also documented properties built before 1965 across 28 Dallas neighborhoods.
local_facts.why_it_matters: Older aluminum frames, single-pane glass, narrow openings, and layered renovation work call for an on-site inspection of the frame, sill, and exterior detailing before selecting an insert, new sash, or full-window replacement.
local_facts.title: Dallas mid-century homes need frame-aware window work

anchors.label: Alteration or repair permit, single-family house
anchors.detail: The adopted Dallas schedule prices alterations or repairs of single-family and duplex structures at $181 per dwelling unit plus $100 for additional trades, with a minimum inspection fee of $125 for one trade. No line item names windows specifically, so the scope of the job decides which line applies.
anchors.source_name: City of Dallas development services fee schedule

anchors.label: Federal window tax credit while it existed
anchors.detail: The 25C credit paid 30 percent of product cost with a $600 annual cap for windows and skylights meeting the ENERGY STAR Most Efficient criteria, for products purchased and installed between January 1, 2023 and December 31, 2025.
anchors.source_name: ENERGY STAR federal tax credits, windows and skylights

anchors.label: Status of that credit for work done now
anchors.detail: The IRS guidance on the 2025 tax law states the credit will not be allowed for any property placed in service after December 31, 2025, so a quote that still prices in a federal rebate is quoting a credit that has closed.
anchors.source_name: IRS FAQs on sections 25C and others under Public Law 119-21
